हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Two city boys enter a cursed village, unaware they’ve stepped into a deadly trap. Drawn to a mysterious, beautiful woman, they slowly realize her charm hides something supernatural. Is she Tilottama—the enchantress whose beauty seduces… and destroys?
